notes:
# Fewer notifications you did not need {iphone}
A Mac on battery is now mentioned only below 50%, and only once — not for
every meeting due and again when the recording starts. And when the capture
moves to the screen, it no longer says you were sharing unless you were.

# Notes say when there is no key {notes}
Switching on “Notes when it ends” without a Gemini key promised a summary
that was never going to be written. It now says so, on the Mac and on your
phone, and still lets you switch it on — the key can go in before the
meeting.

# Removing a folder brings its recordings out {folder}
They used to go back to No folder in the app and stay inside the folder in
Finder. Now they move out with the meetings, and the empty folder goes.

---

Everything else in this release:

- Merging a run's parts into one file keeps what they knew: your voice, the
  chat notice, handouts, the transcript and any notes already made. A
  catch-up run also stays a catch-up run instead of reading as scheduled.
- The battery is still reported at any charge when macOS no longer trusts
  it, or when the charge cannot be read at all.
- The app tells the licence server whether it is a Mac or a PC, and which
  version of the OS. Licence messages now name what is holding a seat, so
  “already in use” says which machine to release.
